## Algebraic structure

<a id="Raising"></a>

### Raising

`Raising` · `src/judgment.ts:29` · status: **held**

The ways of judging harder than the language: nothing raised, every warning an error, the warnings of the codes a project lists made errors; and the harder of two severities. A project's strategy is one of them, with what it lists.

The operations are written in `./code/judgment/raising.ts`.

| Law | Checked |
|---|---|
| Each way raises a problem or leaves it, never lowers it | held on 100 draws |
| As the language says changes nothing | held on 100 draws |
| Every warning becomes an error; an error and a blocking problem stay as they are | held on 100 draws |
| Raising codes makes the warnings of those codes errors, and leaves the others | held on 100 draws |
| The harder of two severities is one of them, at least as serious as both | held on 100 draws |

- Owner: trame
- Serves: [Shared operations instead of literals](product.md#SharedOperations)
- Used by: [As the language says](#AsTheLanguageSays), [Every warning an error](#EveryWarning)
- Applies: [A project judges harder than the language, never softer](#HarderNeverSofter)

## Architecture decision

<a id="HarderNeverSofter"></a>

### A project judges harder than the language, never softer

`HarderNeverSofter` · `src/judgment.ts:113` · status: **held**

A project raises the problems the language judges (a warning it will not leave, by its code), by a strategy of its own; the engine keeps the harder severity whatever the strategy answers.

Context: The language judges every project alike; a project that wants no missing owner, or no warning at all, has no way to say so, and a way to lower a problem would let it hide what the language guarantees.

Consequences: A project chooses a realization of Hardening by a binding where its build evaluates: AsTheLanguageSays, EveryWarning, or one of its own built on Raising (the codes it lists in a decision of its own); the engine keeps the harder of the two severities, and a way that would lower one is an error of the project (hardening-lowers).

| Rejected | Why |
|---|---|
| A decision the engine reads | one way only, the codes listed; a project that wants every warning raised, or to raise by kind, would wait for the engine |
| A rule of std, Raised | a broken rule is one error for all, not each problem raised where it is, with its owner |

- Decided by: trame
- Serves: [Ports of the platform, realized once](product.md#RealizedOnce)
- Applied by: [Raising](#Raising), [Hardening](#Hardening), [As the language says](#AsTheLanguageSays), [Every warning an error](#EveryWarning)

## Port

<a id="Hardening"></a>

### Hardening

`Hardening` · `src/judgment.ts:85`

How a project judges the problems the language raises: the severity it gives each one, by its code, its kind, its module. The engine asks the realization a binding chooses where the project's build evaluates; without one, each problem is as the language judged it.

| Environment | Answered by | Chosen by |

| [Strict](scenarios.md#Strict) | [Every warning an error](#EveryWarning) | [Judged strictly](scenarios.md#StrictJudgment) |
